question: Should this public-comment caller remain a non-merge smoke artifact until the shared runner is demonstrably credential-free and isolated from prompt-injected requests?
rationale: The required isolation boundary is outside this repository-local YAML and determines whether public comments may safely initiate the delegated review path.

options.title: Pause the caller
options.body: Keep this branch non-mergeable or close it as the contributor proposed until the credential-free isolation and adversarial canary are demonstrated.

options.title: Approve after isolation proof
options.body: Permit a refreshed caller only after maintainers review proof that the shared runner cannot expose credentials to model-invoked commands.

recommendation.title: Pause the caller
recommendation.body: Keep this branch non-mergeable or close it as the contributor proposed until the credential-free isolation and adversarial canary are demonstrated.
